C1676.title: Xygeni GitHub Action Tag Poisoning Vulnerability Leads to CI/CD Credential Leak
C1676.summary: On March 3, 2026, attackers exploited leaked GitHub App credentials to conduct a tag poisoning attack against Xygeni's official xygeni-action GitHub Action. The attackers redirected the mutable v5 tag to a malicious commit from an unmerged pull request, causing any workflow referencing @v5 to pull and execute malicious code.
